The '''2015–16  [[Linafoot]]''' season is the 55th since its establishment. [[Linafoot]] is the top-flight association football league of [[DR Congo]] in [[Africa]]. [[TP Mazembe]] won the domestic league.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesz/zaire2016.html Congo-Kinshasa (DR Congo) 2015/16], rsssf.org</ref> The football club drew an average home attendance of 11,888.
